title: Spiced Ethiopian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful lentil stew inspired by traditional Ethiopian cuisine, made with aromatic spices and tender lentils.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the kik and alica spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, water, and aromatic spice blend to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Serve the stew over chewy onion bread or regular bread.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
